# tests/oracle_sweep.py) of tests/data/permutation_regressions.txt rows at which OneLOop 3.6

# differ from the row's reference. These are degenerate D0 kinematics (vanishing invariants
# moved between external and channel positions) where both OneLOop's and these representations
# break down for some labelings; the invariance test skips them.
